how_to_apply: Download the application form from the District NIC Surajpur website https://surajpur.nic.in.
Fill the application in the prescribed format and paste a self-attested passport-size photo at the given place.
Attach self-attested copies of 10th, 12th, B.P.Ed./graduation in Yoga education and experience certificates.
Attach self-attested Chhattisgarh domicile certificate and caste certificate where required, in the order given in the form.
Submit the application in person on the walk-in date, a separate application for each school.
Attend on 7 December 2026, reporting at 11:30 AM.

content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) / graduate degree in a field related to Yoga education Experience: Candidates with work experience in Physical Education/Yoga education will be given preference Age limit: 21 to 35 years Age relaxation: Age relaxation as per prevailing government rules Other conditions: Only residents of Chhattisgarh State are eligible Appointment only after being declared medically fit Desirable: Work experience in Physical Education/Yoga education will be given preference

content_sections.text: Candidates removed by the government or whose service extension has been stopped Candidates convicted of any offence against women or other offence; appointment kept pending while such a case is pending in court

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary engagement up to 31 March 2027 May be extended if the Government of India approves and releases honorarium for the next session Selected candidate must sign an agreement; breach cancels the agreement and ends service without notice No claim to continuous or regular appointment; no court petition for honorarium increase or regularisation

content_sections.heading: How Will Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Receipt and scrutiny of applications Publication of eligible/ineligible list Claims and objections Merit (seniority) list Document verification and selection list 80 percent of the marks of the graduate or equivalent degree in the prescribed minimum qualification Experience in the related field: 3 marks per year, maximum 15 marks National/State level Yoga/Sports certificates: maximum 5 marks Merit and selection list prepared on the above three points; school-wise selection after document verification

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed format with self-attested passport-size photo Self-attested 10th and 12th certificates Self-attested B.P.Ed./graduation in Yoga education certificate Self-attested Chhattisgarh domicile certificate and caste certificate where required Live employment office registration certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the District NIC Surajpur website https://surajpur.nic.in. Fill the application in the prescribed format and paste a self-attested passport-size photo at the given place. Attach self-attested copies of 10th, 12th, B.P.Ed./graduation in Yoga education and experience certificates. Attach self-attested Chhattisgarh domicile certificate and caste certificate where required, in the order given in the form. Submit the application in person on the walk-in date, a separate application for each school. Attend on 7 December 2026, reporting at 11:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the District Education Officer, Samagra Shiksha (RMSA), District Surajpur (Chhattisgarh), dated 23 September 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026, and candidates report at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies for Yoga/Sports Teacher/Coach.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 at 11:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years. Relaxation: Age relaxation as per prevailing government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fixed lump-sum honorarium of Rs. 10000 per month (maximum); no other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) / graduate degree in a field related to Yoga education; experience in Physical Education/Yoga education preferred; residents of Chhattisgarh only.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only residents of Chhattisgarh State are eligible. Appointment only after being declared medically fit.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates removed by the government or whose service extension has been stopped. Candidates convicted of any offence against women or other offence; appointment kept pending while such a case is pending in court.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Receipt and scrutiny of applications. Publication of eligible/ineligible list. Claims and objections. Merit (seniority) list.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary engagement up to 31 March 2027. May be extended if the Government of India approves and releases honorarium for the next session. Selected candidate must sign an agreement; breach cancels the agreement and ends service without notice.
